item.title: Space Engineers - Warfare 3 Pack
item.description:
Title: Space Engineers - Warfare 3 Pack
Genre: Action , Indie , Simulation , Strategy
Developer: Keen Software House
Publisher: Keen Software House
Franchise: Keen Software House
Release Date: Nov 16, 2026




About This Content

Warfare 3 is one of the most significant combat updates we have ever made for Space Engineers.

The Warfare 3 Pack adds over 30 new blocks! These are cosmetic and decorative blocks that don't affect gameplay balance.

If you enjoy Space Engineers and want to support its continued development, this is a great way to do it - and you'll get a lot of new building options in return!

This package includes:

Fighter Cockpit Type II (1xS)

Take control of a next-generation fighter from this sleek, sci-fi-inspired cockpit.

Jump Seat (3xL, 1xS)

Fold it down and strap in. This compact passenger seat is perfect for dropships, tight interiors, and utility craft.

Artillery Turret Type II (1xL)

Give your warship some serious presence with an artillery turret built for heavy engagements and distant targets.

Artillery Cannon Type II (1xL)

Turn distant threats into target practice with this heavy artillery cannon.

Assault Turret Type II (1xL, 1xS)

Hold the line with an assault turret that gives combat-ready grids a tougher, more commanding look.

Assault Cannon Type II (1xS)

Give your gunship a more aggressive profile with an assault cannon designed to look tough and battle-ready.

Autocannon Turret Type II (1xS)

Compact, rugged, and full of attitude. This small turret gives light combat builds a tougher, more intimidating look.

Auto Cannon Type II (1xS)

Small in size but big in style. This autocannon gives your strike craft a true combat-ready look.

Intake Blocks (7xL, 7xS)

Add vents, grilles, and industrial detail to any surface with decorative intake blocks built to make ships and stations feel more complete.

Laser Antenna Type II (1xL, 1xS)

Stay connected across the stars with this advanced communications array.

Brig Doors (2xL)

Keep pirates, troublemakers, and unruly crew members where they belong.

Warhead Type II (1xL, 1xS)

Clean, squared-off, and ready to detonate, this powerful explosive fits neatly into missiles, torpedoes, and compact weapon systems.

Inset Flare Launcher (1xL, 1xS)

Built to blend into your grid, this inset flare launcher lets you fire countermeasures without disrupting your ship’s silhouette.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

The store page localizations for several languages were done by using AI.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Microsoft Windows 10 (latest SP) 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel i5 @ 3.0 GHz or higher (or AMD equivalent)
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Geforce 750/Radeon R9 270X or higher
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 35 GB available space
    • Sound Card: DirectX® compatible on-board
    • Additional Notes: No internet connection needed for single player, but for multiplayer we recommend 5Mbit/s or more
    Recommended:
    • OS: Microsoft Windows 10 (latest SP) 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel Quad Core i7 @ 4.5 GHz or higher (or AMD equivalent)
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Geforce 1070 GTX / Radeon RX Vega 56 or higher
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 35 GB available space
    • Sound Card: DirectX® compatible on-board
    • Additional Notes: No internet connection needed for single player, but for multiplayer we recommend 5Mbit/s or more

item.title: Here Comes the Horde
item.description:
Title: Here Comes the Horde
Genre: Casual , Indie , RPG
Developer: Polished Games
Publisher: Polished Games
Release Date: Nov 16, 2026




About This Game

FEATURES:

  • AUTO-BATTLER WITH TENS OF THOUSANDS OF UNITS

  • INCREMENTAL GAMEPLAY WITH HUNDREDS OF UPGRADES TO UNLOCK

  • 30 LEVELS WITH EVER-GROWING UNDEAD HORDES

  • FULLY VOICED BANTER BETWEEN KING RICHARD AND NECROMANCER MORIANA

You are King Richard, and the evil necromancess Moriana has invaded your realm. Gather your army and defeat the invaders… before they behead you.

Fight through 30 levels , each a bigger threat to your castle walls than the last. Recruit peasants, archers, knights, cavalry, mages, and more until TENS OF THOUSANDS of units clash on the battlefield.

Earn gold by slaying undead enemies and spend it on buildings that send more and more soldiers onto the battlefield. The rest is in their hands… and swords. Watch them die in your name as they try to stop the immense waves of zombies.

Use the souls of defeated foes to unlock new units and improvements between levels , strengthening both your colossal armies and your castle walls. Tip the scales in your favor with hundreds of upgrades waiting to be unlocked , and grow stronger with every battle.

Unlock special abilities to unleash chaos upon your enemies. Man your walls with ranged units, summon tornadoes, or even… explode sheep!

Relax and unwind in this fantasy incremental auto-battler while your loyal and devoted troops fight for you. Fill the screen with your armies, rule the battlefield, and don’t let your enemies get anywhere near your precious castle!

item.title: Clicky Islands
item.description:
Title: Clicky Islands
Genre: Casual , Strategy
Developer: Karrot Games
Publisher: Karrot Games , Pocketpair Publishing
Release Date: Nov 16, 2026




About This Game

In Clicky Islands, you play as a governor appointed by the King, and your mission is to find an island worthy of His Majesty’s future kingdom. Every island starts as a small village. Your goal is to upgrade it, stage by stage, until it’s big and developed enough to be called a Kingdom.

At first, you’ll do a lot of clicking, with recruitable units taking over the work as you grow. Later on, you’ll have to manage production chains and plan your islands to min-max your economy.

When you move on to a new island, your progress stays in the meta tree. Along the way, you’ll find ancient artifacts that you can mix and match to create a playstyle that suits you best.

Gather resources

Start by gathering basic resources with classic clicker gameplay, then recruit units to automate the grind. You'll need mountains of materials to upgrade your island.

Turn goods into gold

You will need a lot of gold to keep growing. Work out what each island is good for, build your production around it and ship your most valuable goods off to be sold.

Watch your settlement grow

Every new stage unlocks more buildings, more upgrades and new ways to push your production even further.

Explore the Meta Tree

During your voyages, you’ll earn reputation. Use it to unlock over 140 powerful perks in the meta tree. Every perk you unlock stays with you, so you start every new run stronger.

Dig up artifacts

Explore ancient ruins on each island to collect fossils. Between islands, break them open to uncover artifacts that change how you play. Like perks, they’re permanent and carry over to every run.

Features:

  • An incremental game with a full-fledged city builder inside

  • 65+ structures and buildings, from humble huts to royal jeweller's workshops

  • Special buildings that unlock unique mechanics

  • Around 50 resources to gather, process, produce and sell

  • 140+ perks to unlock in the meta tree

  • 45 artifacts to mix and match, each changing how you play

  • 45 Challenges (and achievements) ranging from "well, that's easy" to "how is that even possible"

  • 10 island stages, from a camp to a Kingdom, each bringing new buildings, mechanics and production chains

item.title: just volleyball
item.description:
Title: just volleyball
Genre: Action , Casual , Indie , Sports
Developer: temkosoft
Publisher: temkosoft
Release Date: Nov 16, 2026




About This Game

just volleyball is an arcade-style action volleyball game that aims to bring a freeform, addicting, and simple volleyball experience to PC, with full online & offline play. with a cursor-based aiming system and fully manual movement, the game may seem simple to pick up, but has a steep and rewarding learning curve.

features:

  • 1v1s, 2v2s, 3v3s, 4v4s, 5v5s... and 6v6! play whichever format of volleyball you enjoy the most!

  • offline & online play: practice by yourself with bots, or head online!

  • character customization: personalize your player with a simple yet dynamic avatar creation system.

  • replay mode: review your highlights & capture cinematic moments!

item.title: Spirit Crossing
item.description:
Title: Spirit Crossing
Genre: Adventure , Casual , Indie , Massively Multiplayer , RPG , Simulation
Developer: Spry Fox
Publisher: Spry Fox
Release Date: Nov 16, 2026




About This Game

"Imagine Sky: Children of the Light with a dash of Animal Crossing's homey charm" - MMORPG dot com

Welcome to Spirit Crossing , a whimsical multiplayer game set in a storm-swept world above the clouds. Build a home, help spirits, and cross paths with other players, all on your own terms. Make a friend, or just quietly share the same little corner of the world. Our game is built around small acts of kindness, and the way even brief connections can make us feel a little less alone.

Play Together or By Yourself

In Spirit Crossing , other players appear as shadows. Share a high five or an activity, and they'll bloom into color, revealing the person behind the silhouette. Maybe you make a new friend. Or maybe you just fish with each other for ten peaceful minutes and call it good.


Not in the mood to meet or chat with new people? No pressure, you can opt out of meeting others for however long you might want to. Stay a mysterious shadow, lend a hand when you feel like it, and disappear before anyone can make it weird. 🤗

Restore a World of Spirits

Magical storms sweep across the Crosslands, wreaking havoc on spirits and humans alike. Each day brings new quests to rebuild your community, heal troubled spirits, and restore joy through music. As you learn the language of the spirits, they will reward you with unique items and surprising revelations about their stories and struggles.

Show Off Your Style

Show off your unique style with hundreds of designs for every fashionista. Customize your look with hairstyles, dyes, and mix-and-match outfits, then bring it all to life with dozens of expressive emotes. Come as you are, or try on someone new!

Decorate Your Space

A mountain peak escape all to yourself? Now we’re talking! Design the ultimate space to host your friends, from cozy cottage to full-blown castle. Then fill it with enough furniture, plants, rugs, lamps, and tiny trinkets to ensure no shelf goes tragically undecorated. (Oh, and your home might come pre-furnished with a fuzzy, friendly roommate. 🐻)

Cozy Campfires & Impromptu Jam Sessions

Just like in the real world, storms occasionally roll in and interrupt your exploring. But that's a feature, not a bug. In Spirit Crossing , take shelter around communal bonfires with other wanderers. Share a song or conversation, or just simply enjoy the flickering firelight during one of the most magical parts of the game.


What Will it Cost?

Spirit Crossing will launch with an upfront price that gives players full access to the complete game experience in perpetuity. We will also offer a completely optional monthly “Cozy Club” membership for players who want to continue supporting our studio and future Spirit Crossing development. Our Cozy Club members will be able to customize their flying pet fluffalo, collect exclusive flairs, access a limited resource exchange shop, and more! We’re intentionally avoiding microtransactions in Spirit Crossing , so you can focus on enjoying your game, not stressing about your wallet. 💸

What’s With the Bears?

Our studio has been making games for almost twenty years. We invented the Merge game genre with Triple Town , and have since released many other original games, including the hit life-sim, Cozy Grove , and the delightfully silly word puzzle game, Alphabear .

Spirit Crossing has been in development for over five years. At the heart of this project is our belief that games should bring people together, encourage kindness, and reduce loneliness in this chaotic world we live in.

Come join our growing community on Discord today!

Spirit Crossing requires an internet connection to play.
The game encourages players to chat and make new friends. You must be at least 13 years old to play Spirit Crossing.
